verified_facts.fact: Monday 15 February 2027 is 'Washington's Birthday', a U.S. federal holiday.
NYC Hotel Week 2027 runs 2 January – 11 February 2027 with 25% off standard room rates at participating hotels; reservations opened 17 November 2026.
NYC Restaurant Week, Broadway Week and Must-See Week run 19 January – 11 February 2027 with reservations opening 6 January 2027 at 10am ET.
The only officially verified city-wide hotel discount window ends 4 days before the earliest allowed check-in date of 15 February 2027.
Arlo Hotels Cyber Exclusive Access: 40% off Book Direct rates; sale ends 3 December 2026; NYC stay dates through 31 October 2027; code CYBER. Subject to black-out dates and availability.

Marriott CYBER SALE at citizenM New York Times Square: 15% off when booked on the offer page, 25% off for members booking in the Marriott Bonvoy app; 5-day advance prepaid non-refundable rate; promotional code QRI; book by Tuesday, December 1; valid stay dates 29 November 2026 – 2 May 2027.

Two official 7-night quotes were captured for 15–22 February 2027, 2 adults, 1 room: Pod 51 Queen Pod Pod Member Rate $1,109 total including taxes and fees; Arlo NoMad Queen The Steal Deal $1,296 total including the urban fee but excluding taxes.

cheapest_booking_window.answer: NYC Hotel Week 2027 (2 Jan–11 Feb 2027, 25% off) remains the only official city-wide hotel discount, but it ends before the requested 15 Feb–23 Mar 2027 travel window. Two additional official offers DO apply to the requested window: Arlo Hotels' Cyber Exclusive Access (40% off, book by 3 Dec 2026, code CYBER, NYC stays through 31 Oct 2027) and Marriott's CYBER SALE at citizenM New York Times Square (15%/25% off, book by Tuesday 1 Dec, code QRI, stays 29 Nov 2026–2 May 2027).
cheapest_booking_window.best_time_to_book_for_requested_dates: Best verified upcoming booking deadlines: Arlo Hotels Cyber Exclusive Access — book by 3 December 2026 (40% off; code CYBER); Marriott CYBER SALE — book by Tuesday, December 1 (15% off here / 25% members in app; code QRI).
cheapest_booking_window.note: These are the highest verified discounts among the official offers checked, not a market-wide 'cheapest price' proof: no official source compares all NYC hotels or publishes a best time to book. Pod 51's $1,109 all-in 7-night quote is the lowest verified all-in total among the two captured quotes; Arlo's $1,296 excludes taxes and is not directly comparable.

flags: No official source proves a market-wide cheapest date or best time to book; two in-window discounts and two dated 7-night quotes are recorded, with the limitations shown.
